findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager (CFPM) who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

On arrival there was not a CFPM available at the facility. The PIC arrived during the inspection but was without a CFPM as well. They stated that the card needed to pay for the course/test had recently come in and the planned CFPMs would be completing the certification soon. A CFPM must be available at all times that foods and food contact surfaces are handled in the facility. Ensure that enough CCFPMs are available to cover all sifts in the facility.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD.

An employee was observed to don gloves without washing their hands. Education was conducted with the PIC and they were instructed to review hand washing procedures, specifically when to wash, with staff and ensure that all staff know proper hand washing moving forward.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
(REPEAT from the pre-opening) 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

The planned kitchen remodel had not begun at the time of the inspection. Because of this multiple items remain from the pre-opening that require address. Those items include: 1) repair/replace the countertop line where water damage has occurred; 2) fill in the pin holes in the walls where previous equipment used to be anchored; 3) cabinet over the three part sin needs sealed so that the exposed particle boar is smooth and easily cleanable; 4) the cabinets under the three part sink need sealed so that the exposed particle board is smooth and easily cleanable. Ensure that these items are completed prior to the next routine inspection.
